milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Target [20,0,0] (spawn-relative) is the center of the sand area. Player spawns at origin, so they must walk ~12+ blocks east to be within max_distance=8. facing_tolerance=90 is generous since the desert is a large open area. This correctly models 'player has navigated to and can see the desert.'

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Target [12,1,-2] (spawn-relative) is the center of the light_gray_terracotta formation placed at x=10-14, z=-3 to -1, y=64-66 absolute. max_distance=5 requires close approach; facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the formation. Player must turn south from the main eastward path.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Target [12,1,4] (spawn-relative) is the center of the lime_terracotta formation at x=10-14, z=3-5, y=64-66 absolute. max_distance=5 requires close approach. This milestone gates access to the snowball chest behind the formation at z=6.

Uses inventory_has because mining terracotta with a pickaxe drops the terracotta block item into the player's inventory. Checks for uncolored 'terracotta' which is the tallest (4 blocks high) and most prominent formation placed directly in the player's eastward path at z=0-2. The player has an iron_pickaxe provided via /give. Scene design strongly guides the player toward uncolored terracotta first.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Target [27,0,-6] (spawn-relative) is the gate location on the south face of the andesite structure. max_distance=5 requires close approach to the structure entrance. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the gate. The gate is the only entrance to the structure interior.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Target [27,1,0] (spawn-relative) is the interior center of the structure at standing height. max_distance=4 ensures the player has entered through the gate (interior spans z=-5 to z=5). The andesite walls surround the player on all sides once inside.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Target [27,0,3] (spawn-relative) is the interior floor toward the back of the structure. max_distance=4 requires the player to be inside and toward the back. facing_tolerance=90 is wider since the player may look down at the floor or forward while standing on the slabs.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Target [27,2,5] (spawn-relative) is the nether_brick_slab shelf at the back of the structure (y=66 absolute = spawn_y+2, z=4-5). max_distance=4 requires the player to be deep inside the structure. facing_tolerance=60 ensures they look toward the back wall shelf. This is the deepest point in the structure.

Uses inventory_has because crafting snow_block (4 snowballs in 2x2 grid) places the result in the player's inventory. Snowballs are obtained from a chest at [14,64,6] behind the lime terracotta — NOT given at spawn. A crafting table at [15,64,6] provides a recipe hint. The player cannot complete this without first navigating past lime terracotta to find and loot the chest.
